textRuns.value: Peaks over threshold: threshold at the 90th percentile of each country's fire sizes, at least 30 exceedances required to fit (20 of 50 countries qualify), maximum likelihood, 500 bootstrap resamples for the 95 % intervals. Observed level: the size exceeded about once every N years in the record. Reliable horizon: twice the observed period. A description of the 2016-2025 record, not a forecast. Every table carries the MLflow run that produced it.
